title: Welcome to ConfigForge
intro: ConfigForge works in two modes. Pick whichever fits how you'll use it. You can switch later from Paramètres.

author.title: Author baselines anywhere
author.body: Modifier, différence, comparer, and export OSConfig manifestees on any OS. Non extra installs needed.

deploy.title: Author + déployer on this machine
deploy.body: Texte localisé : Windows or Linux. Needs OSConfig installé locally to apply or audit baselines against this device.
